summary:
CEILING AIR VENTS TO BUY: 31 total (28 supply diffusers + 3 return grilles). All are new — MD101 keynote 8 removes the existing ceiling supply grilles and M101 keynotes 2 and 7 call for new grilles ("...field verify exact sizes prior to ordering new grilles"), so nothing is salvaged or reused.

CEILING SUPPLY DIFFUSERS — Price SCD, louvered-face square 4-cone steel, white, 4-way throw, in 24x24 lay-in panel (M601 grille schedule, notes 1/5/7/8/12):
  A — 5 ea @ 6" round neck (75, 75, 75, 90, 130 CFM)
  B — 4 ea @ 8" round neck (150, 150, 140, 140 CFM)
  C — 15 ea @ 10" round neck (2 @ 200, 4 @ 250, 2 @ 300, 3 @ 350, 4 @ 375 CFM)
  D — 1 ea @ 12" round neck (500 CFM)
  Subtotal 25 ea. Each needs a factory-insulated backpan, full-faced louvers, and a radial balancing damper in the neck (Price VCR9 or equal, note 12).
  J — 3 ea Price SMD, 12x12 face with 8" round neck, white, 4-way, surface mount with flanged frame, opposed-blade damper (175, 150, 150 CFM).
  Ceiling supply total: 28 diffusers, 6,550 CFM.

CEILING RETURN/EXHAUST GRILLES:
  F — 3 ea Price 80, 24x24 core, all-aluminum 1/2"x1/2"x1/2" eggcrate, white, core-only panel in 24x24 lay-in ceiling. Keynote 4 requires a new 24x24 lined (1/2" liner) plenum on top; keynote 28 requires a rectangular-to-round adapter atop the return grille. No CFM is tagged on these.

ALSO IN THE CEILING BUT NOT BOUGHT AS GRILLES: 3 ceiling exhaust fans — EF-1 and EF-2 (Greenheck SP-A700, 450 CFM ea) and EF-3 (Greenheck SP-B90, 75 CFM). M601 exhaust fan schedule note 1 says these are centrifugal ceiling fans with an INTEGRAL grille, so the grille comes with the fan — do not order separately. On the plan their tags show a dash instead of a letter.

ONE MORE OVERHEAD DEVICE: 1 ea 14x14 eggcrate, Price model 82, mounted in the exterior soffit with an insect screen on the back (M101 keynote 19). It is untagged on the plan. It is an outside-air intake in a soffit, not a room ceiling vent, so I have kept it out of the 31.

NOT CEILING — 15 SIDEWALL DEVICES (priced separately, don't confuse these with ceiling vents):
  E — 4 ea Price 95, approx. 30x18, primecoat, heavy-duty steel sidewall return. FIELD VERIFY: M101 keynote 7 states the engineer could not field-measure these; contractor must verify exact sizes before ordering.
  G — 4 ea Price 95, 36x36, primecoat, sidewall transfer grille, top elevation 14'-8" AFF (keynote 3).
  H — 3 ea Price 520D, 18x8, primecoat, double-deflection sidewall supply, 550 CFM ea, bottom elevation 11'-11" AFF (keynote 5).
  I — 4 ea Price 520D, 14x8, primecoat, double-deflection sidewall supply, 450 CFM ea. FIELD VERIFY exact dimension before ordering (schedule asterisk).
  E, G, H and I are all primecoat and get 2 coats of field paint — verify color with the architect (schedule note 13).

Grand total of scheduled air devices on M101 = 46 (31 ceiling + 15 sidewall), plus the 3 fan-integral grilles and the 1 soffit eggcrate. Total supply air through all diffusers/registers = 10,000 CFM exactly, which is a good check on the count.

METHOD/CONFIDENCE: I counted the hexagonal device tags on M101 two independent ways — extracting the tag letters as text objects, and detecting the hexagon symbols as vector geometry — and both give exactly 46. Every discrepancy was resolved by zooming in (see excluded false positives). Quantities are firm; the field-verify flags apply only to sidewall tags E and I, so the ceiling order can be placed as-is. Note M601 general note 3: coordinate exact ceiling-device locations with the reflected ceiling plan (sheet on page 29), lighting layout and sprinkler heads — that affects placement, not quantity.

SHEETS USED: M101 (Mechanical New Work Floor Plan) for all quantities and locations; M601 (Mechanical Legend, General Notes & Schedules) for the grille schedule, model numbers, sizes, finishes and exhaust fan schedule; MD101 (Mechanical Demolition Floor Plan) to confirm the existing grilles are removed and none are reused.
